description: This file implements a log tailing utility with classes and functions to tail log files asynchronously, including a TailLog class that manages multiple log file tailing threads, and a tail_logfile function that reads and filters log lines.

classes.name: TailLog
classes.description: A class that manages tailing multiple log files asynchronously, with methods to start, stop, and check if stopped.

methods.name: tail_logfile
methods.description: Function that tails a single log file, reading new lines, applying an optional filter, and writing to a destination stream.

methods.name: TailLog.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the TailLog object with log file paths, destination stream, and configuration options.

methods.name: TailLog.start
methods.description: Starts tailing the configured log files in separate threads.

methods.name: TailLog.stop
methods.description: Stops all tailing threads and waits for them to finish.

methods.name: TailLog.stopped
methods.description: Returns whether the tailing has been stopped.
